palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here's a randomly generated 260-character-long palindrome:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam - level deed civic radar radar level civic malayalam Arora Madam"

This palindrome is created by combining words and phrases that read the same backwards and forwards, along with palindromic numbers and repeating sequences.
